entities.label: Cavern ruler
entities.basis: Distinct ruler negotiates passage and guides the party; session note resolves her as Inakara, but that name is not spoken in this transcript.

interactions.overview: The opening narration recalls that the departing centaurs are going to warn Candrosa about the spreading corruption.
The party recalls Kisa’s account of earlier raids while considering whether the hyena-headed creatures came from another plane.
Seeker tests the stream water on a rabbit, names it Taster, and decides to keep it.

introduction.quote: Previously unnamed rabbit. I now dub thee Taster.

interactions.overview: Seeker reminds the party that only Taster drank the stream water and says to watch for effects.
Seeker takes Taster along as the party leaves the horses outside and prepares to enter the tunnel.
When Kenzo suggests using Taster to test the illusory rubble, someone protectively strokes the rabbit.
The party negotiates passage with the cavern ruler, who makes passage conditional on helping her fight.

introduction.quote: black nails and sort of gray and purple skin that looks bruised

interactions.overview: The party follows the ruler across the pool cavern while she tells her followers that the visitors will kill the creature.
The party questions the ruler about the creature, but she offers little advice and prods them forward to fight.
During the fight, the party notices the cavern ruler watching from the back and chuckling.
After killing the creature, the party asks for safe passage, and the ruler points across the cavern while declining to guarantee their safety.

review_notes: Inakara is a secure identity match from the session note, but the transcript never supplies her name; the display label remains “Cavern ruler.”
Excluded generic roper, anonymous cavern inhabitants, departing centaurs, horses, rumored creatures, and incidental mention of Riswynn’s map-owning relative; combat still has its own scene.
“Tasty” at u0591 is an unconfirmed joking alternative for another rabbit; only Taster is clearly adopted and subsequently used.
Kisa’s information and Candrosa’s warning are reminders of prior events, not new meetings or evidence that either NPC is present.
The speaker of “Stroke the rabbit defensively” at u1306 is Unknown; the overview does not assign it to a particular PC.
The “40 minutes later” at u1261 occurs within a joke about geology, so it does not create a time skip.
Source excerpts are verbatim and retain transcript disfluencies. Scene indexes belong to this extraction, not the existing recap scenes.
